narration: That random text might be readable. Meet CyberChef, a free, open source toolbox that runs in your browser. Here is a Base64 message. Paste it into Input, then add From Base64 to the recipe. Auto Bake turns it into plain English: build something useful. That is decoding, not breaking encryption. You can also chain operations for repeatable data cleanup. This demo uses the official local copy. Save this tool, and follow for more useful software.
